title: dkim.rs returns ParseError for NNTP articles without DKIM-Signature
description: In verify/dkim.rs, when mail-auth's AuthenticatedMessage::parse fails (returns None) the function returns a single ParseError verification result even when the article has no DKIM-Signature header at all. The correct result for an unsigned article is an empty vec (no verification attempted). Fix: before calling parse, check whether any DKIM-Signature header is present in the raw bytes. If not, return vec![]. Prevents false ParseError entries in the verification store.
